messages:
Sara L.: bringing Orbit-3B-int8 up on dev-nucleus-3 for a quick minibatch smoke. anyone around for a 10m sanity sweep?
Miguel R.: on it. will run the small canned QA + the math/verbal probes. are we doing warm cache vs cold too?
Sara L.: yes — run both. config I'm using: ```
model: orbit-3b
precision: int8
batch_size: 8
kv_cache: enabled
warmup_steps: 8
```
dev-bot: Deploy successful: orbit-3b/int8 @ dev-nucleus-3 (container: orbit-int8-2024-11-02) :white_check_mark:
Anya C.: pushed smoke prompt set basic-instruct.json to /tmp/orbit-smoke. kicking off run now. will post quick diffs.
Miguel R.: first pass: FP16 baseline run (same seed) started.
Anya C.: INT8 results coming back — median latency ~98ms, p99 shows spikes ~450ms under batch_size=8. quality: small hallucinations on arithmetic. example: prompt "What is 6 + 7?" -> model: "12".
Sara L.: ugh. check tokenizer and prompt formatting. also compare temperature / sampling seeds.
Miguel R.: running tokenizer diff against fp16 model. quick check: model checksum orbit-3b-int8@sha256:abc123 vs tokenizer package tokenizers@v2.4. Baseline fp16 used tokenizers@v2.3.
ops-bot: Notice: tokenization mismatch increases token count by +1 for some inputs (logged as token_delta).
Anya C.: confirmed — token count off for sentences with trailing spaces. pinning tokenizer to v2.3 and re-run INT8. also enabling explicit strip() in preproc as a stopgap.
Miguel R.: after pin -> p99 latency drops to ~130ms, median stays 100ms. hallucination on simple math persists though (still outputs 12).
Sara L.: that suggests model calibration/regression from quantization. steps: 1) verify fp16 vs int8 logits on that token span 2) check quantization table for numeric tokens 3) run 500-example evaluation to measure accuracy/regression on numeric QA
Miguel R.: running logits diff on that query. quick snippet: ```
# extract logits for token indices
python tools/extract_logits.py --model orbit-3b-int8 --prompt_id 7 --out /tmp/logs
```
Anya C.: sample log: token_indices [23, 45, 78] logits_int8: [-1.2, 0.3, 3.5] logits_fp16: [-0.9, 0.8, 4.1] -> argmax differs. looks like quant rounding of the last token biases toward wrong token.
Sara L.: ok add to checklist: adjust quant calibration (per-token scale) and run quant-aware fine-tune if needed. Also trigger model variant fallback in routing for high-regress cases.
Miguel R.: I added a temporary route: if eval_accuracy_drop > 2.5% then serve orbit-3b-fp16 for the rollout until we fix int8. configured in dev routing: ```
policy: accuracy_pref
threshold: 0.025
fallback: orbit-3b-fp16
```
Anya C.: re-run the 500-example eval overnight with pinned tokenizer + adjusted calibration params. logging eval metrics to /mnt/smoke-results/orbit-int8-1728888888.json
Sara L.: great. follow-up items for onboarding doc: - add tokenizer pinned version requirement - include warm-up prefix recommendation (8 steps) - perf checklist (median/p95/p99) - quant calibration note + example command - rollback/fallback routing snippet. I'll update the onboarding checklist and link it to the model PR.
Miguel R.: if these are green by EOD, we can mark the model as "dev-smoke-passed" and promote to staging for load testing.
Anya C.: noted. I'll post final pass + artifacts in this thread when done. thanks all. :rocket:
